_comment: Hand-authored Templar sim mechanics. Every Num carries confidence. Keys are validated against built skills at build time. Rank-scaled client values use rank 20 (Global cap). Generated by tools/build_mechanics_rules.py.

default.source: default 1.0 s; client cast_time is 0 everywhere; calibrate in app

long.source: no Templar skill is reported as long; value kept for schema parity

duration_s.source: Punishment token se:1209000021:effect_value02:time = 20 at every rank, description 'for 20s' (aion2.app client dump 2026-09-18); gegebase 2026-09: Executor 10s -> 20s on Sep 4

vicious-strike.note: chain 1/3 (client Chain panel), restores 100 MP (description); chain window assumed 3 s

desperate-strike.note: chain 3/3, restores 120 MP (description). Threatening Blow (restores 150 MP) is added as an extra chain step by Vicious Strike spec rank 16; not auto-chained here

threatening-blow.note: restores 150 MP (description); only exists as a chain skill after Vicious Strike spec rank 16

pummel.note: chain 1/2 (client Chain panel); Pummel costs 120 MP, Vicious Strike refills it. Spec rank 16 fires Punishing Strike one extra time (not modelled)

charge_s.source: charge time per level is not published; record a full charge in game to fill in

dmg_mult.source: Metaroad ratio range 430.5-1291.5% and dump flat 1268-3805: level 1 is the minimum (Metaroad Templar page 2026-10-03, aion2.app client dump 2026-09-18)

charge_s.source: charge time per level is not published; record a full charge in game to fill in

dmg_mult.source: linear midpoint between the confirmed endpoints; no source gives the middle level

charge_s.source: charge time per level is not published; record a full charge in game to fill in

dmg_mult.source: max/min = 3.0 for both ratio (1291.5/430.5) and flat (3805/1268) (Metaroad Templar page 2026-10-03, aion2.app client dump 2026-09-18)

punishment.note: Max 3 charge levels; Executor +20% PvE Damage Boost for 20 s on hit. Spec rank 8 'Damage over Time on hit' has no published tick values (not modelled)

doom-shield.note: rush + 75% Knockdown 3 s (100% on NPC targets per description (player chance lower); bosses may be immune to CC (Annihilate text: 'Has a 5% chance to trigger when attacking a target with Incapacitated Immunity'), not modelled); grants Judgment for 3 s (2 s modelled); spec rank 5 resets Annihilate

shield-smite.note: 60% Stun 3 s (100% on NPC targets per description (player chance lower); bosses may be immune to CC (Annihilate text: 'Has a 5% chance to trigger when attacking a target with Incapacitated Immunity'), not modelled); Judgment for 2 s. Spec rank 8: removes MP cost and restores 200 MP, or 50% to trigger Debilitating Smash (not modelled)

shield-rush.note: usable 'after using Dodge or while flying'; 30% Stun 3 s (100% on NPC targets per description (player chance lower); bosses may be immune to CC (Annihilate text: 'Has a 5% chance to trigger when attacking a target with Incapacitated Immunity'), not modelled); Judgment for 2 s. Dodge window length unknown, so the sim falls back to the default status duration with a warning

warding-strike.note: restores HP (rank 1: 180-198) and grants Warding 10 s (defensive); Judgment for 2 s; cooldown 30 s in dump (25 s before Sep 4 per gegebase)

judgment.note: castable only inside the 2-3 s window opened by Doom Shield / Shield Smite / Shield Rush / Warding Strike; whether casting consumes the window is unknown (not consumed here). Spec rank 16 removes its 5 s cooldown

annihilate.note: needs a Stun/Knockdown target; Annihilate itself has 30% to Knockdown (not chained). Spec rank 8: +100% damage to Incapacitated-Immune targets (bosses)

empyrean-lords-punishment.note: 50% Stun 3 s (100% on NPC targets per description (player chance lower); bosses may be immune to CC (Annihilate text: 'Has a 5% chance to trigger when attacking a target with Incapacitated Immunity'), not modelled); 50 Stagger Gauge Damage. Spec rank 15 +10% PvE Damage Boost for 10 s is spec-gated and not applied

assault-fury.note: 30% Stun 3 s (100% on NPC targets per description (player chance lower); bosses may be immune to CC (Annihilate text: 'Has a 5% chance to trigger when attacking a target with Incapacitated Immunity'), not modelled)

capture.note: Root 3 s + 75% Stun 3 s (100% on NPC targets per description (player chance lower); bosses may be immune to CC (Annihilate text: 'Has a 5% chance to trigger when attacking a target with Incapacitated Immunity'), not modelled); a chain skill added by Defiance spec rank 8, cooldown falls 120 -> 42 s over ranks

executing-blade.note: -30% Defense for 5 s; +20% damage vs Impact-type status targets (not modelled)

taunt.note: Enmity +20000 (39000 at rank 20), Shrink 15 s, 50% Taunt 3 s vs players

battlefield-banner.note: Attack scales with Defense; formula unpublished so the status multiplier is unknown

noble-armor.note: defensive; dump cooldown 300 s vs Metaroad 120 s

shield-of-protection.note: guaranteed Block; applies Fury on the assumption the boss hits the tank while Block is guaranteed (Fury needs a Block event). Remove fury_buff from applies for a no-incoming-damage dummy

defiance.note: cleanse + Tenacity 5 s; spec rank 8 adds Capture as a chain skill (not auto-chained: spec unknown to the engine)

dodge.note: opens the Shield Rush window; window length unknown

flash-rampage.note: client: only hits a Staggered target and has 0 cooldown / 0 MP; nothing applies 'staggered' (gauge size unknown) so the sim never casts it rather than spamming it. 4 hits per cast. Spec rank 16: -1 s to all cooldowns on hit
